paper.title_en: A perturbative construction of a modular $S_3$ model for quarks
paper.abstract_en: We present a modular-invariant supersymmetric model of flavour for quark masses and mixing, based on the group $Γ_2\cong S_3$. Hierarchies in the quark sector follow from the symmetric structure of the model, as they are generated by modular forms of different weights in the mass matrices, and no severe tuning of free superpotential coefficients is needed. Moreover, no flavons are employed besides the modulus $τ$ which is, given the gCP symmetry imposed on the model, the only source of CP violation. 8 dimensionless observables (4 mass ratios and 4 CKM parameters) are reproduced by making use of 10 free model parameters (including real and imaginary part of the modulus) within the $1σ$ range making our model, to the best of our knowledge, the $S_3$ modular model for quarks with the fewest free parameters.
